name: The Purist Audit
why: No toppings. Packet-style sauce brune, because if I am going to sit with a plain tray I want the version everybody actually grew up on, not a restaurant improvement. This is the control group.
next_time: Bacon. The control group told me what I needed to know and I do not need to repeat it.

notes: Purist. Fry, curd, gravy, nothing to hide behind

verdicts: Eat it over the tray. Do not attempt the drive home.
Curds are squeaking. The whole point.
Packet-style sauce brune: the line knows what you did and respects it.
Disciplined order. The cook will nod at you once.
